paragraphs.text: Scout is a creature type that first appeared in Mirage . They are individuals who are adept at getting along in the wild, often sharing the benefits of their prowess with others. Some scouts are part of a formal military organization and may have some skills in combat. Many scouts have abilities relating to lands , including landwalk . Scouts appear in all five colors, most often in green and white and least often in black .
According to Mark Rosewater , scout is used for those who are more about venturing forth and gathering intel while ranger is used for those who craft and have an affinity with nature.
Scouts are seen on most planes and vary with some being more military oriented, more magically oriented, or more scholarly oriented. They often are explorers, nature guides, or military outriders.
